title: Explaining Sovereign Bond Yields with Regression
analytical_question: Which macro-financial indicators help explain 10-year sovereign bond yields?

concepts.name: Coefficient
concepts.plain_english: A coefficient shows how much the target variable changes when one explanatory variable increases by one unit, holding other variables constant.

concepts.name: P-value
concepts.plain_english: A p-value gives a rough indication of whether the observed relationship may be statistically meaningful.

concepts.name: R-squared
concepts.plain_english: R-squared shows how much of the variation in the target variable is explained by the model, but a high value does not guarantee a good country-risk model.

review_questions: Do the coefficient signs make economic sense?
Could any variables be highly correlated with each other?
Does the model perform worse during stress periods?
What important country-risk factor is missing from the model?
